title.raw: Thyroid and Parathyroid Diseases and Surgery Clinic
title.rendered: Thyroid and Parathyroid Diseases and Surgery Clinic

content.raw:
This multidisciplinary clinic is dedicated exclusively to diseases of the thyroid and parathyroid glands, offering early diagnosis together with medical and surgical treatment. Specialists from seven fields evaluate each case jointly, following current scientific evidence. MedLuxLife coordinates your assessment, tests and any surgery at our partner hospital, with clear communication at every stage.

Treatments and services

Multidisciplinary team

Specialists in endocrine surgery, endocrinology, nuclear medicine, radiology, pathology, genetics and bioengineering work together on each case.

Thyroid and parathyroid ultrasound

Dedicated ultrasound examination of the thyroid and parathyroid glands.

Scintigraphy

Thyroid (Tc99m), parathyroid (MIBI) and DOTATATE scintigraphy to assess gland function and locate abnormal tissue.

Choline PET

PET imaging that can help locate parathyroid tissue when other tests are inconclusive.

Function tests

Laboratory testing of thyroid and parathyroid hormone function.

Biopsy

Fine needle and Tru-Cut biopsy to examine nodules and suspicious tissue.

Radioactive iodine therapy

Radioactive iodine treatment for suitable thyroid conditions.

Lithium-supported radioactive iodine therapy

In selected cases, lithium may be used alongside radioactive iodine to support the treatment.

Radiofrequency ablation

Non-surgical treatment of thyroid nodules using radiofrequency energy.

Thyroid and parathyroid surgery

Operations using classical and microsurgical techniques, as well as the scarless transoral approach (TOETVA).

Parathyroid transplantation

Reimplantation of parathyroid tissue to help preserve gland function where needed.

Diagnostic and treatment techniques

  • Specific thyroid and parathyroid ultrasonography
  • Thyroid (Tc99m) and parathyroid (MIBI) scintigraphy
  • Thyroid and parathyroid function tests
  • DOTATATE scintigraphy
  • Fine needle and Tru-Cut biopsy
  • Choline PET
  • Radioactive iodine therapy
  • Lithium-supported radioactive iodine therapy
  • Parathyroid transplantation
  • Radiofrequency ablation of nodules (non-surgical)
  • Surgery with classical and microsurgical techniques
  • Scarless surgery (TOETVA technique)

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous thyroid ultrasound and scintigraphy reports
  • Recent thyroid and parathyroid hormone and calcium results

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Thyroid and Parathyroid Diseases and Surgery Clinic consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
